title: How an Aircraft Carrier Serves 15,000 Meals a Day
asof: Figures from US Navy reports 2006–2025 · full video on the channel

shots.s: This kitchen serves more than fifteen thousand meals a day.
It's on USS Ronald Reagan, an aircraft carrier.
The galley never closes. The ship runs twenty-four hours.
Every month: about fourteen hundred gallons of milk,
and over thirty thousand pounds of chicken.
Sailors on watch can't make mealtime, so cooks pack plates to go.
Before USS Carl Vinson deployed, eighteen semi-trucks filled its freezers.
At sea, supply ships pull alongside.
Then everyone carries boxes below, even master chiefs.
And the cooks start all over again.
Could you cook for five thousand people?
